meta.title: LiveStage – Book live performers and buy show tickets
meta.description: Find and book singers, bands and DJs for restaurants, weddings, birthdays and events. See what's on and buy tickets with just an email.

home.quickLink: Not sure who to pick? Get quotes from up to 5 artists
home.tripsSub: Artists on tour take bookings where they are that week
home.privateSub: Filter by budget and guest count
home.step1Text: Date, place, guest count, budget and the songs you want.
home.step2Text: Artists quote, then you agree the setlist and contract on LiveStage.
home.step3Text: Olive holds the money until the show. Contact details appear once the deposit is paid.
home.artistsText: Get booked by venues and individual clients, and open your calendar for tours.
home.heroSub: Singers, bands and DJs for restaurants, weddings and events. Compare quotes, agree the setlist, pay the deposit through LiveStage.
home.trust3: Deposit held by Olive until the show
home.title: Book live music for your room
home.showsSub: A show is guaranteed once half its seats are sold

search.title: Artists in {region}
search.empty: No artists match. Try another date, city or budget.
search.dateHint: With a date, you only see artists who are free and in that city – including artists on tour.

profile.safe: Pay through LiveStage. Phone and email appear after the deposit.

shows.title: What's on
shows.name: Full name
shows.noAccount: No account needed. Your ticket and QR code are emailed to you.

ticket.title: Your tickets
ticket.reserved: Reserved – pay at the door up to 30 min before showtime
ticket.checkIn: Show this QR code at the door to check in.
ticket.lookupSub: Enter the email you used to buy.
ticket.demoNote: The real version emails you a link instead of showing tickets right away.

quote.subQuick: Send one request; up to 5 matching artists will quote.
quote.title: Event name
quote.addressHint: Only shown to the artist after confirmation.
quote.setlistHint: The artist sticks to the songs you pick.
quote.requestsHint: The artist can accept, decline or add a fee. The outcome goes into the contract.
quote.matches: {count} matching artists will get this request:
quote.noMatch: No artists match this date and city yet.
quote.needAccount: Log in with a venue or client account to send a request.
quote.wrongRole: Artist and Olive accounts don't send quote requests.

errors.date: Pick today or a later date.
errors.noArtists: No matching artists to send to.

booking.contactsLocked: Contact details appear after the deposit

contractStates.none: The contract is created when the artist sends a quote.

booking.contractNote: Changing the price, setlist or extra songs creates a new version that both sides agree to again.
booking.payNote: Paid to Olive through Stripe. Olive holds it and pays the artist after the show.
booking.payNeedsContract: Both sides need to agree to the contract before the deposit.
booking.maskedNote: Phone numbers, emails and links stay hidden until the deposit, so all talks and payments go through LiveStage.
booking.privateLabel: Private event – the public schedule shows the city only
booking.notFound: Booking not found, or you can't view it.

dash.calendarHint: Click a day to mark it busy or free. Busy days are visible to you and Olive only; clients just see that you're not taking bookings.
dash.publicNote: Clients see public shows (venue, time) and “Private event, city”.
dash.tripsHint: Add the days you'll be in another city. During a trip you only appear in that city's search.
dash.songsHint: Starred songs appear in the quick view and on your profile. Clients pick setlists from this list.
dash.oppsHint: Open venue slots that match your act and the days you're free in that city.
dash.slotHint: Matching artists see the slot. The first to take it is confirmed; with ticketing on, the show appears on What's on.
dash.feeHint: Set per artist. Clients and venues never see this.

forArtists.title: Get booked through LiveStage
forArtists.sub: Venues and individual clients find you by date, city and budget.
forArtists.b1Text: Clients see where and when you perform. Busy days and requests stay private.
forArtists.b2Text: Tell us when you'll be in another city and take bookings there.
forArtists.b3Text: Clients pick from your songs. You decide on requests outside your list, and any extra fee.
forArtists.b4Text: Clients pay the deposit on LiveStage. Olive pays you after the show, minus the agreed platform fee.

footer.about: Book live performers and sell show tickets in Vietnam and Canada. Run by Olive.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may have changed or no longer exists.

login.title: Log in to LiveStage
login.sub: Ticket buyers don't need an account.
login.magicHint: We'll email you a link to log in.
login.magicSent: If this email has an account, a login link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam).
login.linkError: This link has expired or is invalid. Please try again.

register.title: Create an account
register.sub: Ticket buyers don't need an account.
register.sentText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.sub: Enter your account email and we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam).

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.sub: Choose a new password for your account.

errors.passwordLong: Password can be at most 72 characters.
errors.cityRegion: That city isn't in the selected region.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Email not confirmed yet. Check your inbox to activate your account.
errors.noProfile: This account has no LiveStage profile. Contact Olive for help.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Please log in.
errors.passwordWeak: That password is too weak. Choose another.
errors.rateLimited: Too many emails sent. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.linkExpired: This reset link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.samePassword: The new password must differ from the old one.

ticket.cardNote: Paying by credit card adds {pct}. Other methods have no surcharge.
ticket.guaranteedHint: More than {pct}% of the seats are sold, so this show is confirmed.
ticket.needMore: {count, plural, one {# more ticket} other {# more tickets}} and the show is guaranteed
ticket.needHint: A show is guaranteed once {pct}% of the seats are sold. If it does not go ahead, you are refunded in full.
ticket.lineupKeep: Your ticket stays valid. Refunds are available until the day before the show.
ticket.cancelledText: The venue called this show off before it reached half its seats. Every ticket was refunded in full.
ticket.refundCancelled: The show was cancelled, so this ticket was refunded.
ticket.refundLineup: You took a refund after the line-up changed.
ticket.refundNote: Keep your ticket, or take a full refund until the day before the show.

venue.comboHint: Show only is {show}. Olive takes {venue} of show tickets and {combo} of combos. Set the price to 0 to remove the combo.
venue.subTitle: Replace the artist
venue.subHint: If the deal with the announced artist falls through, put another artist of the same kind on the bill. Ticket holders are emailed and keep their tickets.
venue.subNone: No other artist of this kind is free that day.
venue.resHint: Table requests from the widget on your own website. Confirm them here; guests get an email.
venue.widgetTitle: Take reservations on your own website
venue.widgetText: Paste this code into the Reservations section of your site. Guests book a table or buy show tickets without leaving it, and the bookings appear in your dashboard.
venue.preview: Preview on a sample restaurant site
venue.openWidget: Open the widget on its own
venue.cancelHint: Under 50% sold, you can still call the show off until {date}. All {count} ticket orders are refunded in full.

embed.title: Reservations
embed.dateHint: Set by the show if you picked one
embed.name: Full name

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.date: Pick a date from today on.
errors.full: No table left at that hour. Try another time.

embed.siteNote: Sample restaurant website. The Reservations section below is the LiveStage widget, added with one line of code.
embed.siteIntro: Book a table, or join us on a live music night. Tickets include an option with dinner.

pay.cardNote: Paying by credit card adds {pct}. Other methods have no surcharge.

order.title: Group order
order.add: Add more artists to this order
order.addHint: Book several artists for the same event in one go. Each artist sends their own quote and you pay one deposit per artist.
order.alsoBusy: {name} is not available in that city on that date. Untick them or change the date.
order.payAllHint: {count} artists have sent a quote and contract. One payment covers their deposits.

admin.ratesHint: These rates apply to every transaction in both regions. Each artist can also have their own rate, set on the Artists tab.
admin.readOnly: Your role can see the rates but only a super admin can change them.

rateHint.artistBps: Default commission on an artist's fee, for new artists
rateHint.venueBps: Commission on a venue's show-only ticket revenue
rateHint.customerBps: Service fee added to tickets and deposits
rateHint.cardBps: Added when the customer pays by credit card
rateHint.comboBps: Commission on combo tickets, in place of the venue rate

admin.incomeNote: On {revenue} of ticket revenue, including {combos} dinner + show tickets.
admin.teamHint: Who operates the platform and what each role can do.

perms.super: Everything, including rates, artist fees and the team.
perms.support: Bookings, tickets, messages and flags. Cannot change rates or fees.
perms.recruiter: Own pipeline of artists and agencies. No bookings, no money.
perms.manager: Acts for the artists on the roster: quotes, contracts, messages.

admin.resetHint: Puts every booking, ticket and account back to the initial sample data. Accounts registered since are removed.

recruit.name: Artist or agency
recruit.signedHint: A signed artist gets an account invite. An agency gets one manager account that acts for all of its artists.

manager.hint: You act for these artists: answer requests, send quotes, agree contracts and message clients on their behalf.
